known_issues: Planner coverage is unstable under bounded request budgets and repeatedly misses lower-ranked semantic tests.
A standalone GET without resource setup can turn an expected missing-resource 404 into a false contract failure.
The semantic report omitted real failed/error observations in four runs; deterministic completeness validation safely used a factual fallback.
notes: Strict results were recalculated after removing an unnecessary diagnostic-action requirement from duplicate_email_accepted.
backend_unavailable accepts either a confirmed or possible finding because transport failure does not itself prove an API contract defect.
This is a small repeated regression benchmark, not a claim of general model accuracy.
